verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair axis for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence never documents versioning, review/approval, or rollback of automations. The nearest items are adjacent: prompt versioning in AI Configs, a gate kill switch, scheduled rollouts, and CLI use in CI/CD pipelines, which is a user-side workaround. None of these earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
